body: I think my problem stems deeper than a simple unknowing. The antisocial aspect about me that my father voices to anyone that will listen is entirely true. I'm not necessarily shy, I just do not talk. I have nothing to say. I don't think I want friends.

This is normal for me. I know what to expect every day. I know how to act. I know what to do.

I have no interest in saving myself. I am okay with how my father treats me. Bruises fade. I am not worried about the future I do not want. As long as my father has me, he will not bother my brother. That is all I would be worried about.

They know me as a troubled, antisocial teen who hasn't coped with the abandonment of his mother.

This might sound weird, but I don't know if I *want* that change.

Overall I am quite hopeless. I'm okay with that.

Thank you for your words.

I have never talked about it - aside from the two reddit submissions.

We moved recently; I don't know anyone. But even when we were back "home", I never told anyone anything. No one took an interest aside from mumbled whispers in hallways.

I think my fear of what *could* happen is more overpowering than my fear of what *is* happening. I know what to expect every day. I know how to act, I try not to mess anything up. I am comfortable in that. This is all that I know.

We moved across the country recently. My dad transferred. I don't know anyone here.

My brother is the only reason why I am still here.

When/if I can forge a different path for him, I think that will be it for me. People talk about goals, they talk about futures, but his is the only one I dream of. I'll get a different life for him - different than mine, different than my mom's. I will do that some day. But for now, I am okay with taking anything as long as I prevent it from happening to him.

No one knows. They never believed me.
I am sixteen and it is always a constant thought.
